summary: ATS Corporation filed a Form 6-K disclosing participation in the Jefferies Industrials Conference and routine activity under its normal course issuer bid (NCIB). The company reported purchasing 1,119,413 shares at an average price of $27.97 through August, including previously disclosed shares. The NCIB allows repurchase of up to 8,225,621 shares through December 21, 2026. This is standard capital return activity, not a special situation event. No board recommendation, advisors, or structural terms are disclosed beyond ongoing share buybacks. Watch for continued buyback execution rather than any strategic shift.
